Partnervest Advisory Services Llc increased its stake in Microsoft Corp (MSFT) by 23.91% based on its latest 2018Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Partnervest Advisory Services Llc bought 4,188 shares as the company’s stock declined 1.64% with the market. The institutional investor held 21,703 shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2018Q3, valued at $2.48M, up from 17,515 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Partnervest Advisory Services Llc who had been investing in Microsoft Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $782.57 billion market cap company. The stock increased 4.65% or $4.53 during the last trading session, reaching $101.93. About 44.06M shares traded or 5.32% up from the average. Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) has risen 30.43% since January 6, 2018 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 30.43% the S&P500.
